causes.label: demand
causes.quote: extreme temperatures in South Australia resulted in near-record demand.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: An unplanned outage of the Moorabool No 2 220kV busbar and the subsequent offloading of two 220 kV lines - Moorabool to Ballarat No 2 and the Mooraboool to Geelong No 1 - at 12.38 pm required four additional constraints to be invoked to manage the new configuration of the network.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: The new limit, however, was violated - there was insufficient online spare capacity in South Australia to meet the step change and a conflicting network constraint prevented flows of more than 85 MW into Victoria.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The limit for flows across Murraylink into South Australia changed from a maximum of around 110 MW into South Australia at 12.45 pm to forced flows of more than 160 MW into Victoria at 12.50 pm.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: all online plant in South Australia was dispatched at either its maximum capability or ramp up rate until 1.05 pm.

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink
interconnectors_named.quote: forced counter price flows from South Australia across the Murraylink interconnector.

interconnectors_named.name: Snowy to NSW interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: The constraints invoked to manage the network outage also impacted on the dispatch of the Snowy to NSW interconnector.

interconnectors_named.name: Snowy to Victoria interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: the step change in the Snowy to Victoria limit caused an equivalent change for flows between the Snowy region and New South Wales.

interconnectors_named.name: Basslink
interconnectors_named.quote: At 12.51 pm there was an unplanned outage of Basslink, which lasted until 8 January.

intervals.quote: The constraints were invoked for the 12.50 pm to 1.05 pm dispatch intervals inclusive.
intervals.text: The constraints were invoked for the 12.50 pm to 1.05 pm dispatch intervals inclusive, and the spot price reached $5057/MWh at 1 pm.

network_outages.quote: On Monday 31 December at 12.45 pm an unplanned network outage at Moorabool in Victoria caused a step change on flows across Murraylink, forcing flows out of South Australia. This step change led to high priced capacity being dispatched and dispatch interval prices of up to $10,000/MWh in South Australia.

peak_price.quote: Five-minute dispatch prices in South Australia reached $10,000/MWh as all online capacity was dispatched at either its maximum capability or ramp up rate until 1.05 pm.
